name: Mac Óc
text: Mac Óc is a patronymic form of the name of Angus Óg. MacKillop also lists the short form Óg under this headword. Irish sources name the same divine youth Aengus. The entry works as a signpost to the article on Angus Óg.

attributes.attribute: Patronymic form attached to Angus Óg
Shorter form Óg appears under the same headword

okr.objective: Documents the patronymic name forms Mac Óc and Óg that designate Angus Óg.
key_results: Mac Óc and Óg stand as patronymic forms of Angus Óg.
The entry directs readers to the Angus Óg article.
The forms identify one divine youth rather than separate figures.
